notes: IdentityUnits has a no-argument constructor that mints 1,000,000,000 UI with 18 decimals once to msg.sender. It has no administrative powers, transfer fees, or external mint or burn functions. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The pool uses the requested paired token with a 0.3% fee and tick spacing 60. initialPrice records floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply) * 2^96), assuming UI is currency0 and the paired token is currency1, for provenance only. The deployer derives the actual opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply with the deployed currency ordering.
